targetUniverse: All official regular-season finished games returned for each season through cutoff; missing months must remain explicitly incomplete
deduplicateBy: official GameId; reconcile actual detail date and teams against schedule; ambiguous identities excluded
trainingEligibility: Actual local date strictly before target actual local date, maximum 6 baseline / 24 candidate prior team games, no cross-season carryover
baseline: Unmodified production projectCpblRotationStarter, 6 prior team games
candidate: Frozen empirical cadence helper from previous limited audit, 24 prior team games
outcome: Verified actual first-pitch starter from official explicit role reconciled against first inning live log; unavailable/conflicting identity excluded
deploymentGate: No automatic promotion. Require complete schedule/detail acquisition, no leakage, consistent improvement on newly acquired games, coverage tradeoff disclosed, and runtime cost assessed. Otherwise retain production algorithm.
limitations: Retrospective event-time replay from later-fetched records is not an archived acquisition-time prediction.
2026 August/September audit results already known; exclude those games from newly acquired subset.
2025 earlier-year validation is external-year retrospective validation, not prospective unseen holdout.
Raw API zero rows cannot prove no games occurred.

diagnosticComparisons.purpose: Separate improved history coverage from formula change; no parameter tuning or cherry-picked promotion
